# Guildframe

> Independent campaign design studio for tabletop Kickstarter and Gamefound projects, led by Umair.

This is a supplemental service summary. It does not replace the HTML pages or sitemap.

## Current service facts

- Campaign design: $975 USD per agreed campaign, for Kickstarter or Gamefound.
- Scope: page structure, copy shaped from supplied project facts, visual direction, section graphics, reward comparisons and stretch goal graphics where needed.
- Free mockup: an opening campaign section to explore a direction, with no payment or obligation to book.
- Timing and exact deliverables: confirmed in the written brief before the full project begins.
- Contact: umair@guildframe.com.
- Categories: board games, card games and TCGs, TTRPGs, miniatures and terrain, dice and tabletop accessories.
- New game illustration, video production, advertising, production and fulfilment are separate from campaign page design.
- Concept imagery: original fictional games generated with ImageGen and labelled as concepts.
- Past work: ScentedRealms, FutureProof Terrain and Quiver Time, linked to their real Kickstarter campaigns. Original campaign artwork and a credited Quiver Time product photo illustrate this section.
- Testimonials: two verbatim client excerpts matched to ScentedRealms and FutureProof Terrain. No funding result is attributed to design.
- Older Shopify articles are retained as after-funding references. The former paid Build Guide and Shopify build offers are no longer promoted.
- No promise of funding success or search rankings.
